subject: Insurer naming cascade + COI sequencing for MSA & Order Form
messages:
From: Jill Park <jill.park@skycloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@skycloud.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Insurance evidence & naming — SkyCloud onboarding (DEAL-9182)

Hi Kimberly / Sean,

Following our procurement checklist: attached is SkyCloud's standard COI/endorsement requirements (SkyCloud_COI_requirements.pdf). A few items for clarification before we execute the order form + MSA:

- SkyCloud requires Additional Insured endorsement naming: "SkyCloud, its subsidiaries and affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees and agents".
- COI must list insurance limits matching the order form schedule (Cyber: $5M, GL: $2M, E&O: $5M).
- Certificate needs to be issued no more than 30 days prior to effective date; endorsement must be attached.

Can you confirm Redwood can: (1) add that exact additional insured language as an endorsement; (2) accept COI delivery via secure upload to contracts@skycloud.com or we can provide broker contact?

We need evidence on file prior to signature to meet our internal audit gating. ETA on response?

Thanks,
Jill Park
Senior Contracts Manager — SkyCloud

Attachment: SkyCloud_COI_requirements.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jill Park <jill.park@skycloud.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Insurance evidence & naming — SkyCloud onboarding (DEAL-9182)

Thanks Jill — looping Sean for visibility.

Quick answers and proposed next steps:

1) Baseline: Redwood's standard coverage meets GL and Cyber limits you listed; E&O (professional liability) is typically provided via our cyber policy (we'll confirm the carrier and limits).
2) Additional insured: we can typically provide an endorsement to name SkyCloud and related affiliates, but legal needs to confirm specific wording/cascade.
3) COI delivery: we prefer broker upload to a secure intake link; if SkyCloud requires the certificate sent elsewhere, please confirm broker contact.

Next steps:
- I'll attach a short factsheet with our baseline coverage and carrier contacts.
- Sean / Legal should review endorsement wording; can we aim to have a proposed endorsement by EOD Friday (6/15)?

Sean — can you confirm if we accept the 30-day certificate window (SkyCloud wants <30 days before effective date) or if Procurement needs a closer window?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-insurance-factsheet.pdf

Subject: Re: Insurance evidence & naming — SkyCloud onboarding (DEAL-9182)

Kimberly — thanks. Looping in Aditya and Marissa to expedite.

Jill — appreciate the doc. Quick operational asks from our side:

- We can provide an endorsement matching SkyCloud's requested cascade but need to confirm exact legal phrasing. I've attached a proposed endorsement template (proposed-endorsement-Wording.docx) that follows our carrier's typical language. If your broker can accept our template with minor edits, that will speed things up.
- For COI timing: we typically require a COI within 14 days before signature for larger deals; if SkyCloud's policy is 30 days, we can be flexible but need the certificate no later than signature date.
- Please provide broker contact or confirm upload path so we can ask our broker to route the docs.

Action items:
- Aditya (Legal): review proposed endorsement and advise if the wording will trigger any exceptions in the MSA.
- Marissa (Finance): confirm whether the 14-day window is acceptable from a revenue recognition / billing start perspective or whether we should accept 30 days.

Jill — can your team provide broker contact and an expected date for certificate delivery?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jill Park <jill.park@skycloud.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Insurance evidence & naming — SkyCloud onboarding (DEAL-9182)

Thanks — reviewed the proposed endorsement. A few legal points and a requested MSA redline snippet:

1) Endorsement wording: acceptable with the following tweak to avoid open-ended affiliate exposure. Please have broker adopt this exact language on endorsement wording and on the COI schedule:

  "Redwood Inference agrees to endorse the policy to name 'SkyCloud Technologies, Inc., its subsidiaries and affiliates, and their respective directors, officers, employees and agents' as Additional Insured with respect to liability arising out of services provided by Redwood under the Agreement between the parties."

2) MSA / Order Form linkage: please add a clause to the Order Form referencing insurance schedules ("Order Form Appendix A — Insurance Schedule") so the limits called out in SkyCloud's COI map directly to the financial obligations and any indemnity carve-outs. This avoids later disputes about which policy covers what.

3) Timing: we accept the 30-day issuance window for the certificate as requested, provided the endorsement is attached and the COI lists the carrier and policy number. However, Insurance evidence must be uploaded or sent to insurance@redwood.com at least 48 hours before countersignature. If the broker needs an alternate routing, coordinate with Kimberly.

4) Attachments: added a short MSA redline snippet for the insurance section (msa_redline_insurance_snippet.docx). If SkyCloud insists on broader affiliate naming, Legal will need to evaluate on a case-by-case basis.

Please confirm when Aon can deliver the endorsement with the exact phrasing above. Once we have the COI + endorsement, Finance and Sales can finalize sign-off.

--
Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

Attachment: msa_redline_insurance_snippet.docx
